Variants.Content: Sarsfield City is located in the western hilly area and is the center of the castle connecting the mining territory and the agricultural and pastoral hinterland. The wealth of the Westerlands has never flowed into Casterly Rock automatically: the mine roads have to be maintained, the animals have to be transported, the caravans have to obtain the permission of the lord, and the merchants have to bear the risk of bandits and road collapse. Local castles such as Sarsfield are responsible for linking underground resources, above-ground property and road order. Its residents may not have any direct connection with the royal capital's conspiracy, but they can immediately feel the politics of distant places from the price of gold, war requisitions, and currency shortages.

Entry Sarsfield Keep A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Sarsfield Keep They care about the mines, pastures, mountain roads, the circulation of gold and silver, and the market under the protection of Casterly Rock. They also look at whether seeds are left after the grain collection and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see the coat of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
